scope: Actual gifts, restitution, refusal, owned goods and executor-delivered interpersonal disagreement
checks: PASS Two actual adult residents exist
PASS A carried real item can be given to the nearby resident
PASS The gift changes inventory and ownership exactly once

PASS A recipient without physical room refuses a gift without deleting it
PASS An executor-delivered local disagreement changes both participants' named relationships
PASS No gift or refusal duplicates a possession ID
PASS Social transactions and their real possessions validate together
PASS captured session validates with conversation memories
limitations: AI disabled: conversation delivery and effects tested, not model semantics.
